title: Syrian Lentil Pilaf
description: A flavorful and hearty pilaf dish made with Syrian lentils, pilaf, and spices, inspired by French cuisine.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the Syrian lentils, pilaf, and lightly spiced mixture. Stir to combine.
Add the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
